etymologies.etymologyHTML: From a Niger-Congo language, compare Temne kola, Mandinka kola. The beverage "Coca-Cola" was what made the term widely known, and popularized the spelling with c instead of k.

definitions.definition: The kola plant, genus Cola, famous for its nut, or one of these nuts.
A beverage or a drink made with kola nut flavoring, caramel and carbonated water.

quote.citation: 2008, Alexandre Allauzen, Review of “Mathematical Linguistics” by Andras Kornai‎[1]:
quote.text: In this part, the author presents a prosodic hierarchy describing syllables, moras, feet, cola and a typology for words and stress.

definitions.definition: A cluster of buds on a cannabis plant.
